html.content:
Recommended

Correlationscore: 1.0

Symmetric heatmap of pairwise correlation coefficients.

Clinical use: Lab correlation matrix, biomarker panel correlations

  • 2+ numeric → pairwise corr
  • many numeric vars → matrix useful

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='correlation matrix heatmap'

Alternatives

SPLOMscore: 1.0

Scatter plot matrix — all pairwise scatter plots in a grid.

Clinical use: Pairwise biomarker exploration, PK parameter matrix

  • 5+ numeric → pairwise scatter matrix

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot matrix of <numeric variables>'

Histogramscore: 0.9

Binned frequency distribution of a single continuous variable.

Clinical use: Baseline characteristic distribution

  • 1+ numeric → frequency distribution
  • no category → single variable focus
  • enough data for bins

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='histogram of <numeric>'

Scatter2Dscore: 0.8

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • sufficient points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

ParallelCoordinatesscore: 0.8

Parallel axes — each line is an observation, axes are variables.

Clinical use: Multi-endpoint profile per subject, multivariate QC

  • 3+ numeric → parallel axes
  • 4+ axes — parallel coordinates clearer than heatmap

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='parallel coordinates of <numeric variables> colored by <factor>'
